name: TagInput
description:
Free-entry chips: email recipients, IP addresses, labels. Enter, comma, semicolon or
Tab turns the text into a chip; pasting a list adds every value at once. Values are
normalised and de-duplicated (adding one again flashes the existing chip); invalid ones
stay visible in danger with the reason. Chips are edited in place with Enter or a
double-click. With suggestions or a source, the list offers matches and “Create "x"”.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, suggestions, source, allowCreate, normalize, validate, max, onErrorChange, wrap, placeholder, size, width, icon, disabled, readOnly, invalid, name, id, onBlur, className, ref, ...aria }: TagInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: allowCreate
props.description: Offer “Create "x"” when the text matches no suggestion (default on).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the control box.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon element without an explicit size; the component sizes it through its tokens.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid. Pair it with an accessible validation message.

props.name: max
props.description: Most chips allowed.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: normalize
props.description: Tidy a value before it becomes a chip (trim is always applied): lowercase an email…

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the text input loses focus, so a form can mark the field touched.

props.name: onErrorChange
props.description: The first problem (an invalid chip, or the limit) — show it in the field's message line.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the full list of tags whenever one is added, edited or removed; typing alone does
not call it. Pair with `value` to control it; use `defaultValue` otherwise.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: source
props.description: Or suggestions searched on a server.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Static suggestions, filtered as you type. Optional: free entry works without any.

props.name: validate
props.description: Why a value is not valid, or nothing. Invalid chips turn danger; the reason is their tooltip.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: width
props.description: Available width or named width tier.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Let chips wrap onto more lines (default). Off: one line that folds into "+N".
